claim: E: the plan-noise movability measured in iteration 4 (FP8 W8A8 engine) is a property of the 8-bit arithmetic, tested by a 2x2 weight-by-activation precision factorial on identical inputs

outcome_definitions.Y_correct: passed AND label not in {default, invalid} ('other' counted as off-default)
outcome_definitions.Y_correct_catalogue_only: passed AND label not in {default, invalid, other}

verdict_rule.PRECISION EFFECT: both T10 and T2: diff >= threshold and McNemar p < 0.01
verdict_rule.backend: verdict stated for EMU; REAL repeats the McNemar as the kernel check

attribution_rule.ACTIVATION: AME >= 0.20 and WME < 0.10 and AME slot-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0
attribution_rule.WEIGHT: WME >= 0.20 and AME < 0.10 and WME CI excludes 0
attribution_rule.INTERACTION: W8A8-W16A16 >= threshold while W8A16-W16A16 < 0.10 and W16A8-W16A16 < 0.10
attribution_rule.scope: PN_a2, per task, then pooled over T10+T2 stratified by task; population check = same rule on per-direction mean shares of the 40 directions

consequence_rule.PRECISION EFFECT: every iteration-4 internal claim (same-seed contrast, task-spec site, plan noise as the cheapest knob, frozen screen) is written as a property of the FP8 W8A8 engine; the effect is reported as a deployment finding, with the attribution class
consequence_rule.NO PRECISION EFFECT: the unit cross locates the iteration-5 shrinkage; the iteration-4 claims are restored as model properties

gate_rules.REAL: byte identity with exp19 on 25 TWIN + 25 PN_a1 slots when the card is the iteration-4 type; on another sm_89 SKU (here L4) report the identity rate and apply the EMU criteria
gate_rules.EMU: twin label agreement >= 0.9 on 25 T2 slots (W1 k0-9, W2 k0-9, W3 k0-4); PN_a2 shares inside iteration 4's 95% CP intervals (correct-only like-for-like)
gate_rules.W16A16_anchor: label agreement >= 0.9 with 25 exp27 TWIN slots (T10, W1-W5 k0-4)
gate_rules.failed_gate: does not stop the factorial; the verdict is written as conditional on emulation

drop_order_time_only: 40 directions under W8A16/W16A8 down to N 5 (k 0 only)
REAL T03 and REAL population cells
never_drop: W8A8/W16A16/W8A16/W16A8 TWIN+PN (core) on T10 and T2

device_rule.batch_composition: one (task, template, prompt ids) per batch; B = 20 -> exp19 pairs [TWIN k0-9 + PN_a0.5 k0-9], [PN_a1 k0-9 + PN_a2 k0-9]; 40-direction arm: 10 directions x k0-1
